title: Podcast Refine
description: Turns the LLM's answers (answers lane) into an explainable, validated candidate list. Episode analysis: merges the per-part answers, snaps every proposal to sentence boundaries, enforces the length limits, removes overlaps, keeps the best N by weighted score (hook / clarity / standalone), dedupes chapters and writes analysis/candidates.json + chapters.json. Prompt Director (a chat question with 'project:' and 'request:' context on the questions lane): loads the request spec, enforces the hard constraints (speaker, subject, exclusions, duration window, complete thoughts, no overlaps), ranks on prompt match / hook / standalone / clarity / energy and writes analysis/requests/<id>.json with a compliance report. The manifest is returned on the answers lane.
